name: Lunaris
description: A clean, minimal ROM focused on stability and performance. Smooth animations, optimized battery life, and a near-stock experience with useful customizations.

name: Evolution X
description: Pixel-inspired ROM with tons of customization options. OTA updates, Pixel features, and a huge theme engine. Best of both worlds.

name: crDroid
description: Feature-rich ROM based on AOSP with a focus on customization and performance. Tons of toggles, lockscreen options, and status bar tweaks.

name: AxionOS
description: A lightweight AOSP-based ROM with carefully selected features. Fast, clean, and gets out of your way.

name: Project Infinity X
description: Endless customization possibilities. A ROM built for power users who want full control over every aspect of their device.

name: Project ASCP
description: Android Security & Customization Project. Hardened ROM with extra privacy controls and security patches alongside customization.

name: Rising OS
description: A rising star in the custom ROM scene. Clean UI, thoughtful features, and excellent device support. Built to impress.

name: Avium UI
description: Elegant and smooth ROM with a focus on UI polish and user experience. Beautiful animations and a refined design language.
